sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Sandeep Maniji Bakhshi Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Ashok Kumar Singh Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Heard Sri Sandeep Maniji Bakhshi, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri A.N. Mulla, learned A.G.A. appearing for the State.
The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the F.I.R. dated 06.11.2022 registered as Case Crime No. 257 of 2022 under Sections 406, 419, 420 IPC, Police Station Rudhauli, District Basti.

Submission of learned counsel for the petitioner is that husband of the petitioner late Satish Chandra who was running an investment firm, had died as such no offence against the petitioner is made out, who has no concern with the same.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, Sri A.N. Mulla, learned AGA has pointed out that late Satish Chandra (husband of the petitioner) was running a firm alongwith co-accused Sohrat Lal and they got the money deposited in the name of investors firm and defrauded of the depositors.
In the meantime, Satish Chandra has committed suicide.
As per ?Suraksha Patra? issued in favour of the investors, family members of the petitioner were liable to refund the amount.
It is further submitted that it is not the only case.
There are allegations against the petitioner as well and as reflected from the FIR, a large number of persons have been defrauded.
Submission is that cognizable offence of a public nature has been made out in the present case.
Perusal of the impugned first information report prima facie reveals commission of cognizable offence.

Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
